files.docs/text-policy.md:
# Catalog identifier policy

Use canonical decomposition followed by canonical composition.
Do not apply compatibility decomposition: a circled digit such as ① must remain distinct from 1.
config/catalog.ini selects the Unicode normalization form.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then update the configuration: https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr15/ . Read docs/text-policy.md, config/catalog.ini, and data/display_names.txt. Use Table 1 in the Unicode report to choose the one normalization-form acronym that satisfies the local policy. Actually change only the value after normalization= in config/catalog.ini; preserve its other text and all other files. Do not normalize the sample file itself.

turns.final: Set normalization=NFC: canonical decomposition followed by canonical composition, preserving compatibility distinctions.
